definitions.explanation: Describes conditions, quality, or environments that are extremely bad or substandard. Stronger than simply 'bad' — implies conditions that are seriously inadequate or harmful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{劣悪|れつあく}だ。
{劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}っている→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧。
examples.english: Inferior quality products are circulating in the market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{衛生|えいせい}→衛生：14049_eisei⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Disease spreads easily in areas with terrible sanitary conditions.

notes:
A strong, somewhat formal word typically used to criticize conditions or quality — especially in discussions of labor, living conditions, and product quality. Not typically used to describe people directly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (terrible environment)
- {劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (terrible conditions)
- {劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ (inferior quality)
- {劣悪|れつあく}な⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧ (terrible treatment)
